content:
The image shows a mango leaf with numerous small, dark (black/dark brown) spots scattered across the surface. The leaf has a yellowish-green color overall, suggesting stress.

Key observations:
- Small dark spots distributed irregularly across the leaf surface
- Spots appear flat/superficial rather than sunken or raised
- No powdery white coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No gum secretion or bark/twig withering visible (rules out Die Back)
- The dark spots look like superficial dark fungal growth on the leaf surface, consistent with Sooty Mould (black soot-like encrustations)
- The spots don't show the characteristic sunken lesions with red halos of Anthracnose

The pattern matches Sooty Mould: black superficial encrustations on leaf surface from dark fungal mycelium growing on insect honeydew secretions.
